description: This file defines the CanvasScheme enum that provides URL construction and MIME type utility functions related to the application's canvas scheme and resource types.

methods.name: makeURL(session: String, path: String? = nil)
methods.description: Constructs a URL using the defined scheme, session, and optional path.

methods.name: mimeType(forExtension: String)
methods.description: Returns the MIME type string based on the file extension.
